submitter: bugs_open/440 lane, phase 2 (producer conversion) — the round the phase-1b council itself made necessary. That round's bug_historian seat objected that proving the routing key at ONE producer says nothing about the others; the census answering it found the fixed creator mints 1 of 3,172 reason-bearing items. This submission converts the remaining Go page_rerender producers through ONE shared helper. Phases 1a (livespec foundation, corr 55def842) and 1b (creator stamping, corr 934327db) are both APPROVED and shipped. The gate still reads spec.reason — the FLIP is RFC_062 phase 3, owner-ruled 2026-09-03 (D1-D5) and not in this submission.
rationale: Every producer must stamp spec.routing_reason beside spec.reason before RFC_062's gate can narrow to the routing key; narrowing while producers are unconverted would route ~3,100 items to assemble — this bug's own shape, fleet-wide, inside its own fix. The obvious implementation adds the key at each call site, which re-creates the defect this lane is closing one level along: a vocabulary judgement copied to N sites, which then drift (bugs_open/404 IS that story — the gate knew five values and Go knew three). So the pair is defined ONCE, in platform/livespec beside the vocabulary it depends on, in two forms for the two spec-construction styles the estate actually uses (Go maps; backticked JSON templates), with the JSON form DERIVED from the map form by marshalling rather than hand-written a second time, and a test that composes the two and requires them to agree. ENUMERATION WAS THE WORK, and it corrected my own published figure: the phase-1b round recorded '13 Go files write an in-vocabulary reason', which is true and is NOT the conversion set. Reading each site's item type [MEASURED 2026-09-03] found only FIVE are page_rerender producers; four nearby sites write a DIFFERENT item type — render_directory_action.go and reconcile_section_data_action.go file needs_page, store_generated_component_action.go files needs_rerender (its reason is propagated into page_rerender items BY the creator, which already stamps), and discovery_checks/check_literal_markdown.go files item_type 'literal_markdown' (matching bugs_open/404's own finding that literal_markdown never appears on a page_rerender item). A blanket sweep over the 13 would have stamped page-rerender routing decisions onto items no rerender gate reads. Of the five, FOUR are converted here; the fifth (refresh_evidence_base_action.go) is deliberately NOT in this submission because another session has 245 uncommitted lines in that file right now — converting it would have taken their half-finished work into this commit.

plan.summary: One new livespec file defining the reason/routing_reason pair once (map form, spec-map stamper, and a derived JSON-object-prefix form whose TRAILING COMMA makes the empty case compose into valid JSON) plus its tests; four call sites converted to use it — two Go-map specs in discovery_checks and two backticked JSON templates. Additive and inert: no gate reads routing_reason until RFC_062 phase 3.

edits.rationale: ONE definition of how a page_rerender spec carries its reason. `reason` is always written as given (the annotation is never validated — owner ruling D4); `routing_reason` only when the value is in the vocabulary, so an out-of-vocabulary reason yields no routing key and phase 3 can never refuse an item the estate's own producers minted (REB-008). The JSON form is derived from the map form, not written twice. Its trailing comma is a safety property, not a style: callers write `{%s"page_name":%q}` so BOTH the stamped and empty states emit valid JSON — the comma-separated alternative emits `{,"page_name":...}` the first time anyone passes a variable that is empty, writing invalid JSON into a text column. The header states the item-type scope so the next reader does not repeat the blanket-sweep error.

The unknown case is poisoned with REAL observed values (tool_retirement, light_palette_chrome_replaced) and with free prose of the exact shape migration 696 mints, and asserts its own precondition that each is still out-of-vocabulary — failing loudly with 'pick another' rather than going quietly vacuous if a later lane declares one. The prefix test COMPOSES the fragment the way call sites do (prefix then another field) for known, unknown and EMPTY reasons, which is what makes the trailing-comma design load-bearing rather than stylistic.

Go-map spec: build the map, stamp via the helper, then marshal — so the cta_links_stale judgement is no longer a bare literal in a check file. Item type confirmed page_rerender at the call site before converting.
Same conversion, same shape; the file's existing comment already explains why section_data_resolved is the right reason here, so the helper call sits under it rather than restating it.
Backticked JSON template: the hardcoded reason pair becomes the derived prefix, keeping the template's other fields and their order untouched.
Same conversion for the image_landed producer (item key page_rerender:<page>).

grounded_in: Why one definition rather than N literals — the vocabulary's own history [platform/livespec/rerender_reasons.go header]: 'The Go action that STAMPS reasons onto items carried its own hardcoded copy of that list, and the fixer that files items carries a third copy in raw SQL... So the gate knew five and the Go reader knew three.' Adding the routing key at each site by hand would restart exactly that.

The item-type enumeration that corrected my own published '13 Go files' figure [read at each call site, 2026-09-03]: page_rerender producers = refresh_evidence_base_action.go (deferred, see risks), render_news_section_html.go, flag_page_image_rebuild_action.go (itemKey 'page_rerender:%s'), discovery_checks/check_misdirected_cta.go (ItemType: "page_rerender"), discovery_checks/check_contact_form_undeliverable.go (ItemType: "page_rerender"). NOT page_rerender: render_directory_action.go (itemType: "needs_page"), reconcile_section_data_action.go (itemType: "needs_page"), store_generated_component_action.go (item_type 'needs_rerender'), discovery_checks/check_literal_markdown.go (ItemType: "literal_markdown").

The config door is EMPTY today [live DB, 2026-09-03]: SELECT type, count(*) FROM agent_definitions WHERE is_active AND NOT is_snapshot AND deleted_at IS NULL AND default_config::text ~ '"reason"\s*:\s*"(cta_links_stale|section_data_resolved|template_changed|literal_markdown|image_landed)"' returns ZERO rows — no live agent config stamps an in-vocabulary reason via spec_literal. A snapshot, not a guarantee; the phase-3 census re-runs it.

The conversions EXECUTED, not asserted [2026-09-03]: a scratch program reproducing each converted template verbatim printed — {"reason":"section_data_resolved","routing_reason":"section_data_resolved","page_name":"about","page_id":"pid","domain":"d.uk"}; {"reason":"image_landed","routing_reason":"image_landed","page_name":"about"}; and for the empty reason {"page_name":"about"} — all three parse, which is the trailing-comma property proven by execution rather than by reading.

Isolation from neighbouring lanes' in-flight work [2026-09-03]: verify-head-builds --with (my six files) against HEAD — ./platform/orchestration/actions/... and .../discovery_checks ok. platform/livespec FAILs on TestNoNewMigrationFileReadersOutsideTheAllowList both WITH my files and, as a control, at HEAD WITHOUT them: identical failure, so it is the 405 lane's pre-existing RED (ffa1707b3, ~8 days), not this change.
plan.risks: (1) SHARED FILES, and one already bit: refresh_evidence_base_action.go — the fifth page_rerender producer — carries 245 uncommitted lines from another session right now (a FactsUnverifiable/attestations feature, with two of its own tests currently red). My two-line conversion there was written and then REVERTED rather than committed, because a pathspec commit takes the file from the working tree and would have swept their half-finished work under this message. It is recorded as the one deferred conversion, to be done when their work lands; phase 3's census will catch it if it is forgotten. (2) The four converted files are additive and inert — no reader of routing_reason exists until phase 3 — and the item type at each was confirmed at the call site rather than inferred from the reason value. (3) The JSON-prefix form is string composition into a JSON template, which is fragile in general; the trailing-comma design removes the only failure mode that does not require a caller to hand-edit the template, and the empty-case composition is asserted in the tests and proven by execution. (4) This does not complete phase 2: the raw-SQL migration door (the dominant unguarded producer) is the authoring rule + pattern-check advisory, deliberately left to its own round so this one stays reviewable — pattern-check.py is in council scope (2026-08-24) and will be submitted separately.
